grouped_help_entries.name: scan
grouped_help_entries.description: what your local coding-agent work costs — no key, no network, 10s

grouped_help_entries.name: init
grouped_help_entries.description: one-command setup: caps + identity + auto-wire your $0 lanes (--all also wires gate/MCP/receipt/rule/skills)

grouped_help_entries.name: run
grouped_help_entries.description: `run -- <cmd>` gate ONE command; nothing written to your interpreter

grouped_help_entries.name: sources
grouped_help_entries.description: where can this machine spend? providers · agent tools · ungated venvs

grouped_help_entries.name: doctor
grouped_help_entries.description: is the gate enforcing HERE? keys, lanes, ledger status

grouped_help_entries.name: health
grouped_help_entries.description: bounded MCP health check of lanes and metered providers (--no-run = no probes; --json)

grouped_help_entries.name: ask
grouped_help_entries.description: run ONE prompt across many LLMs — honest per-vendor coverage, $0 lanes

grouped_help_entries.name: comprehend
grouped_help_entries.description: fan a CORPUS across the $0 lanes (doc-mining/gap-analysis) — NOT Claude sub-agents; estimate-first

grouped_help_entries.name: delegate
grouped_help_entries.description: classify then offload one self-contained task to another subscription plan; dry-run by default

grouped_help_entries.name: serve
grouped_help_entries.description: the ask surface over localhost HTTP — POST /ask from any tool/language

grouped_help_entries.name: mcp
grouped_help_entries.description: spendguard's tools over MCP (stdio): model-advisor + spend/compaction queries

grouped_help_entries.name: install-mcp
grouped_help_entries.description: register `spendguard mcp` in Claude Code (~/.claude.json); --remove to undo

grouped_help_entries.name: reap-orphans
grouped_help_entries.description: inspect or reap warm-lane servers whose marked owner is provably dead

grouped_help_entries.name: queue-manage
grouped_help_entries.description: reclaim, retire, purge, and conditionally drain the durable lane queue

grouped_help_entries.name: lane-leak-check
grouped_help_entries.description: detect protected subscription-lane or metered-provider leakage

grouped_help_entries.name: ledger-read
grouped_help_entries.description: bounded read-only events, calls and exact counts; oversized reads fail loud

grouped_help_entries.name: receipt
grouped_help_entries.description: running tally: today / 7d / month, two axes

grouped_help_entries.name: report
grouped_help_entries.description: daily · weekly · monthly, per provider (+ leak alert)

grouped_help_entries.name: reconcile
grouped_help_entries.description: `reconcile all|openai|anthropic` — ledger vs the provider's BILL

grouped_help_entries.name: trust
grouped_help_entries.description: is what we recorded ≈ what you were billed?

grouped_help_entries.name: close
grouped_help_entries.description: monthly close: provider truth + residual, named

grouped_help_entries.name: focus-export
grouped_help_entries.description: the ledger as FinOps FOCUS 1.2 rows (json|csv) for any FinOps stack

grouped_help_entries.name: otel-ingest
grouped_help_entries.description: import an OTel GenAI trace (OpenLLMetry/Traceloop) → spend_events (idempotent)

grouped_help_entries.name: keys
grouped_help_entries.description: spend per API key (which workspace/project key)

grouped_help_entries.name: coverage
grouped_help_entries.description: which LLM-capable interpreters are NOT gated

grouped_help_entries.name: overage
grouped_help_entries.description: is the subscription plan on paid per-token overage right now?

grouped_help_entries.name: advise
grouped_help_entries.description: cheapest config that HELD quality, per intent (the auto knob: reasoning='best-value')

grouped_help_entries.name: bakeoff
grouped_help_entries.description: measure cost×quality for a SLATE of untried models on an intent's tasks (feeds advise); --temperature/--seed for a deterministic A/B

grouped_help_entries.name: stability
grouped_help_entries.description: measure a model/lane's RUN-TO-RUN variance at production settings (replicates) — the stability question temp=0 can't answer

grouped_help_entries.name: effort-titrate
grouped_help_entries.description: learn the CHEAPEST reasoning effort that HOLDS quality, per (intent, model)

grouped_help_entries.name: calibrate
grouped_help_entries.description: learned estimator: your history corrects the naive $

grouped_help_entries.name: prompts
grouped_help_entries.description: lint the call corpus for prompt waste

grouped_help_entries.name: experiment
grouped_help_entries.description: A/B a cheaper config with graded output-equivalence

grouped_help_entries.name: maxtokens
grouped_help_entries.description: measured p99 bound for a call class (autotune's input)

grouped_help_entries.name: tokens
grouped_help_entries.description: per-provider token factors: `tokens calibrate` picks o200k→native AGENTICALLY from call_io stats (--dry-run=$0)

grouped_help_entries.name: realized
grouped_help_entries.description: what the changes actually saved

grouped_help_entries.name: savings
grouped_help_entries.description: what spendguard SAVED — measured + counterfactual, by source (the 3rd axis, never summed)

grouped_help_entries.name: measurement
grouped_help_entries.description: receipts for a judged number: `measurement inspect|list|reconstruct` — the judge/sample/rubric behind it

grouped_help_entries.name: saas
grouped_help_entries.description: `saas link|sync|push|reconcile|reattribute` — org roll-up (opt-in)

grouped_help_entries.name: lanes
grouped_help_entries.description: subscription lanes: run meta prompts on your plan (+ `lanes set-model <lane> <model>`)

grouped_help_entries.name: tiers
grouped_help_entries.description: bulk-lane routing groups: show/validate + `tiers set <group> <model…>`

grouped_help_entries.name: truth
grouped_help_entries.description: push provider-truth totals (owner only)

grouped_help_entries.name: config
grouped_help_entries.description: `config` show all · `config set <section.key> <value>`

grouped_help_entries.name: install-hook
grouped_help_entries.description: gate EVERY process in a venv (opt-in; --uninstall removes)

grouped_help_entries.name: gate-host
grouped_help_entries.description: offer/apply import-time gating to every discovered unregistered interpreter

grouped_help_entries.name: install-agent-gate
grouped_help_entries.description: hard-route reroutable Agent/Task spawns off a near-cap hosting plan

grouped_help_entries.name: install-capguard
grouped_help_entries.description: guard Claude subagent and raw codex-exec spawns at low weekly headroom

grouped_help_entries.name: install-rule
grouped_help_entries.description: teach Claude/Cursor to route generated code through the gate

grouped_help_entries.name: install-skills
grouped_help_entries.description: add the /spend, /spendguard-* slash commands

grouped_help_entries.name: schedule
grouped_help_entries.description: OS-native daily sync (launchd / cron / schtasks)

grouped_help_entries.name: sync-prices
grouped_help_entries.description: refresh the price breadth layer now

grouped_help_entries.name: sync-catalog
grouped_help_entries.description: refresh the live model-catalog (validates model ids at dispatch)

grouped_help_entries.name: sync-capabilities
grouped_help_entries.description: sync per-model capabilities (vision, response_schema, …) + upper bounds from LiteLLM

grouped_help_entries.name: balances
grouped_help_entries.description: per-vendor metered prepay balance (sunk-pool vs on-demand), for routing

grouped_help_entries.name: reliability
grouped_help_entries.description: sweep every lane ($0) + metered provider (--run) for reachability; --remediate = agentic per-lane FIX (which login/quota/API to fix), cached; --notify = macOS notification on any red

grouped_help_entries.name: preflight
grouped_help_entries.description: resolve model ids (served + priced; stale→fix) BEFORE a batch — catches a bad id for $0

grouped_help_entries.name: verify
grouped_help_entries.description: self-check every money path: model ids · failover map · keys · economics (--probe = live)

grouped_help_entries.name: keys-audit
grouped_help_entries.description: scan repo .env files for a provider key that would SHADOW the keys.env SSOT (the stale-shadow 401 doctor can't see)

grouped_help_entries.name: consumer-audit
grouped_help_entries.description: prove every workspace LLM consumer is gated and on the deployed sha; safely arm fixable venvs

grouped_help_entries.name: distribute
grouped_help_entries.description: converge every local surface and attest the deployed release; --check verifies without mutation

grouped_help_entries.name: manifest
grouped_help_entries.description: build or show the persisted complete inventory of gated surfaces

grouped_help_entries.name: deploy
grouped_help_entries.description: run the full gate, then promote committed HEAD → green pointer (running MCP servers roll onto latest+best)

grouped_help_entries.name: release
grouped_help_entries.description: show release status, then converge and attest the fleet (--check verifies only; --json)

grouped_help_entries.name: fleet
grouped_help_entries.description: tracked consumers and deployments (--restart, --json, or deregister <python_executable>)

grouped_help_entries.name: pricing
grouped_help_entries.description: print the canonical price table

grouped_help_entries.name: audit
grouped_help_entries.description: fail CI if any code hardcodes a disagreeing price

grouped_help_entries.name: token-caps
grouped_help_entries.description: list every hardcoded output-token cap; --judge rules on the unjudged ones

grouped_help_entries.name: metadata
grouped_help_entries.description: model-metadata backbone health: LiteLLM cache + measured-cap drift

grouped_help_entries.name: estimate-divergence
grouped_help_entries.description: judge every recorded quote against the actual bill; fails on ungrounded ones

grouped_help_entries.name: estimate-literals
grouped_help_entries.description: every cost call fed literal token counts; --judge rules quote vs probe

grouped_help_entries.name: migrate
grouped_help_entries.description: rebuild spend_events from charges (exact Decimal); proves Σ preserved
